reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and copy-paste what I need, and I'm not letting an AI answer my customers on its own 24/7 when one wrong reply can cost me a client I spent years earning. At 99 euros a month on 36,000 a year, it has to prove itself first, so at most I'd poke at the free plan.
objection: An AI talking to my customers without me checking could say something wrong and damage my reputation, and I don't see what this does that my ChatGPT subscription doesn't already do for a fraction of the price.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to approve every customer-facing message before it goes out, plus a real example from a small business like mine showing hours saved, with a free trial long enough to test it on my own customers.
